name: Jùlóng
source:
On the other side of Alice Gate, one can find a tailless young dragon called Jùlóng. It speaks like a gyaru too!

This dragon seems to have the information Hikari is after. Being neither her friend nor her foe, however, it isn't willing to share.

Jùlóng is friends with Nene. She gave it the nickname [i]Kahogon[/i], as the dragon acts protective of her.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/2063243560363917631]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
